confidence_legend.classical: Documented in classical texts (Mayamata, Manasara, Samarangana Sutradhara, Brihat Samhita, Agni Purana, Vishvakarma Prakasha)
confidence_legend.traditional: Widely practised; texts/regions vary on details
confidence_legend.modern: Contemporary practice without classical textual basis
confidence_legend.verify: Real tradition, formulation needs edition check before quoting or computing

safety_rules: Never advise demolition, structural alteration or unsafe works; refer to a qualified engineer/architect.
Remedies are optional and proportionate; zero-cost conduct/usage changes first.
No guarantees; no fear-based claims; no fabricated verse citations.
Ayadi measurement formulas remain disabled until edition-verified.
sources: The Penguin Guide to Vaastu (Sashikala Ananth) — modern practice
Vaastu: The Indian Art of Placement (Rohit Arya) — modern practice
Vaastu: The Global Science (B. Niranjan Babu) — modern practice

puja.label: Puja / meditation room
puja.notes: Never under a staircase; idols away from toilets; keep light and clean.

kitchen.label: Kitchen (fire)
kitchen.notes: Cooking platform in the SE of the kitchen; not facing the main door. A NW kitchen appears in some modern variants only.

master_bedroom.label: Master bedroom
master_bedroom.notes: Head toward south or east; avoid head directly north and feet toward the door.

children_bedroom.label: Children's bedroom
children_bedroom.notes: West supports study and growth; avoid the SW authority zone.

guest_room.label: Guest room
guest_room.notes: Keep transient; a NE guest room tends to become permanent clutter.

living_room.label: Living / family room
living_room.notes: Morning light preferred; heavier seating toward S/W of the room.

dining.label: Dining
dining.notes: Face east or north while eating; dining west supports digestion per tradition.

study.label: Study / office
study.notes: Face north or east while working; not under a staircase.

store.label: Store room
store.notes: Heavy goods in the heavy zone; never in the wealth zones N/NE.

staircase.label: Staircase
staircase.notes: Rise clockwise seen from above; avoid directly facing the main door.

toilet.label: Toilets / bathrooms
toilet.notes: Never sharing a wall with the puja room; keep doors closed and dry.

garage.label: Garage / parking
garage.notes: Vehicles parked facing outward where practical.

main_door.notes: Opens inward; no pole/tree/toilet/staircase directly facing it; avoid exact alignment with a rear opening.

compound.wall_height: higher/thicker on South and West; lower/lighter on North and East
compound.setbacks: more open space on North and East

defects.pattern: Toilet or extended toilet in the North-East
remedies: Shift toilet use to NW/W over time
Keep the NE room light, clean and dry
Place a puja/meditation function in the NE space
Relocate cooking platform to the SE of the existing kitchen if possible
Use the SE corner as the primary fire zone
Avoid storing heavy items in the NE

defects.pattern: Master bedroom in North-East or South-East
remedies: Shift the primary bedroom to the SW over time
If NE: keep the room light and use it for study/puja instead
Rotate the bed head to south or east

defects.pattern: Overhead water tank in the North-East
remedies: Move the tank to SW/W at the next plumbing change
Keep the NE load light in the meantime

defects.pattern: Underground water tank in the South-West
remedies: Prefer moving the source to N/NE/E when feasible
Do not deepen the SW excavation

defects.pattern: Site slopes or drains toward South/West
remedies: Regrade surface drainage toward N/NE (engineer to confirm)
Add planters/levels to slow water at the SW

defects.pattern: Main door on an inauspicious pada (Yama/Roga/Asura/Shosha/Papayakshma)
remedies: Keep the entrance well-lit, clean and unobstructed
Use an auspicious secondary entrance for daily use if one exists
Door-position changes require professional advice

defects.pattern: Toilet, kitchen, staircase, bed or pillar at the Brahmasthan (centre)
remedies: Remove load/occupancy from the exact centre where possible
Keep the centre open, light and uncluttered
Never place a toilet at the centre; consult a professional for built obstructions

defects.pattern: Staircase in the North-East or directly facing the main door
remedies: Screen the view with a partition/plant
Use a different staircase for daily movement if available
Plan relocation at the next renovation with an architect
Keep the NE area light, open and water-balanced
Add a small water feature or light plants in the NE (modern practice)
Do not add heavy storage in the NE

defects.pattern: South-West extension beyond proportional plot limits
remedies: Balance with open space and light in the NE
Keep SW rooms heavy and stable
Structural correction only via professionals

defects.pattern: Large tree at the centre or heavy trees in the North-East
remedies: Remove only with municipal permission and arborist advice
Thin branches rather than felling where possible
Plant light, non-thorny plants in the NE

defects.pattern: T-junction or dead-end directly facing the entrance
remedies: Keep the entrance lit and unobstructed
Use a screen/planter to soften the direct line (safe, non-structural)
Avoid mirrors directly facing the door

defects.pattern: Beam or heavy load directly over the bed head or puja place
remedies: Reposition the bed/idols away from under the beam
Use a false ceiling to visually soften (professional)

defects.pattern: More open space on South/West than on North/East setbacks
remedies: Keep the N/E side light and open
Add low planters rather than heavy construction on the N/E

defects.pattern: Toilet sharing a wall with the puja room
remedies: Relocate the shrine to the NE/E/N of another room
Keep the shared wall dry and clean; no images on it
Long-term: separate the uses at renovation

bhoomi_puja.notes: Auspicious day/lagna; avoid Rikta tithis (4/9/14), Amavasya and Bhadra; traditionally the NE corner is broken first.
bhoomi_puja.use: muhurta engine with event=general until an edition-verified bhoomi-puja list is added

shilanyasa.notes: First stone/foundation block; construction sequence traditionally begins at the SW.

main_door_installation.notes: Door frames set in an auspicious lagna, avoiding Rahu Kala and Bhadra.

griha_pravesh.notes: Use the muhurta engine event=griha_pravesh (Rohini/Mrigashira/Uttara Phalguni/Chitra/Anuradha/Uttara Ashadha/Uttara Bhadrapada/Revati; fixed lagnas; personal tarabala).
